name: 90717 · Lomita, CA
findings: ZIP 90717 (Lomita) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90717 (Lomita) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90717 (Lomita) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
